answer: Creating N fake participants costs N bonds plus N attestation trials, so a violet-flagged cluster of fresh identities with no dune of history simply burns capital. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond that unlocks only past a fixed horizon, and reputation accrues from peer-attested work rather than registrations. Attackers must sustain real stake and genuine peer validation across epochs, making mass identity inflation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
